description: Sprint handoff by team and ending sprint. General activity and reconciliation use unqualified created/merged populations in each handoff window, not whole-sprint totals. The WI package selector applies only to dedicated qualified follow-up panels. Qualified follow-ups require matching linked-WI sprint and latest target-package evidence; historical package values and causation are not established. Shared CD/test signals are deduplicated per sprint, not attributed to a team or package. Calendar dates are exposed in the evidence section.

panels.title: Sprints that ended in the selected time range

panels.description: Distinct PRs merged on the last two working days of their sprint (days −2 and −1 before the sprint finish).

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOSprintHandoffTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Sprint:singlequote}) or Sprint in (${Sprint:singlequote})) and ExpectedFinish ge ${__from:date:seconds} and ExpectedFinish lt ${__to:date:seconds} and Kind eq 'MergedPR' and DaysFromSprintEnd ge -2 and DaysFromSprintEnd lt 0)/groupby((RecordId))&$top=20000

panels.title: PRs merged in the last 2 days

panels.description: Distinct PRs created in the first three days of the next team sprint, with at least one linked WI assigned to the ending sprint in its current or recorded initial iteration. The same WI must have a usable target package matching the package filter. All packages includes any recorded target version. Package values are latest WI snapshots, not historical assignments. Unverified links are excluded. Temporal proximity does not prove a test fix.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOSprintHandoffTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Sprint:singlequote}) or Sprint in (${Sprint:singlequote})) and ExpectedFinish ge ${__from:date:seconds} and ExpectedFinish lt ${__to:date:seconds} and Kind eq 'CreatedPR' and EarlyNextSprint eq 1 and (Kind ne 'CreatedPR' or EarlyNextSprint ne 1 or (('__all' in (${PackageVersion:singlequote}) or PackageVersion in (${PackageVersion:singlequote})) and SprintLinkEvidence in ('CurrentAssignment','RecordedInitialAssignment') and PackageVersion ne null and PackageVersion ne '' and PackageVersion ne 'N/A')))/aggregate(RecordId with countdistinct as QualifiedPRs)

panels.description: PR identities are deduplicated by organization, project, repository and sprint. Created = both + created without a merge event in the selected window; merged = both + merged without a creation event in that window. The latter is not automatically prior-sprint carryover: verify lifecycle dates and team calendars. This is not a complete open-backlog balance. Package qualification is excluded. Each query is capped at 20,000 PR/sprint identities.
